descricao: Folhas de referência (model sheets) do elenco fixo. Gere cada folha uma vez no Higgsfield (Nano Banana Pro, 2k, 16:9), confira contra a descrição fixa, salve no arquivo indicado e suba com media_upload; anote o media_id aqui. Em todo prompt do dia, passe em medias, com role "image_references", a folha de cada personagem listado em personagem_referencia do dia.
gerado_por: instagram/ferramentas/normalizar-dias.mjs (o media_id preenchido à mão é preservado)

personagens.descricao_fixa_en: a round pale-lilac macrophage blob with short stubby pseudopods, big friendly eyes, a red-and-white checkered napkin tied around the neck and a small blank ID badge on a lanyard
personagens.prompt_folha: Colorful editorial cartoon illustration, clean vector-like shading, thick rounded navy outlines, Road to America brand palette of navy #0f2747, red #b0243a and white, with small green #1d8a4b and yellow #f1c232 accents, on a flat paper background in #f3f5f2. Character model sheet of one recurring cartoon character: Macrô, a round pale-lilac macrophage blob with short stubby pseudopods, big friendly eyes, a red-and-white checkered napkin tied around the neck and a small blank ID badge on a lanyard. Show the same character on one sheet, evenly spaced on the flat paper background: a full-body front view, a full-body side profile view, a full-body three-quarter view, and a row of four head close-ups with different expressions (happy, surprised, tired, focused). Identical proportions, colors, outfit and outline thickness in every view, neutral standing pose in the three turnarounds, only the fixed props of the character. Wide 16:9 sheet. No text, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no watermark, no real people, no patients, no blood, no gore.
